stemEn: An infant presented to ER with inspiratory stridor (croup-like picture) and severe respiratory distress. His SpO2 is 92% in room air. What will you give him?
explanationAr: الصورة السريرية تمثل moderate-to-severe croup مع stridor وrespiratory distress. Nebulized epinephrine يعطي تحسنًا سريعًا بتقليل airway edema، بينما dexamethasone مهم أيضًا لكنه أبطأ في بدء المفعول.
reasoningEn: Nebulized epinephrine is used for rapid relief of moderate-to-severe croup symptoms. Dexamethasone should also be given but does not act as rapidly.
incorrectOptionsAr: Dexamethasone مفيد لكل درجات croup لكنه ليس الأسرع لتخفيف obstruction الحاد. Antibiotics لا تُعطى في viral croup الروتيني.
clinicalPearl: Moderate-to-severe croup: give corticosteroid plus nebulized epinephrine and observe for recurrence.

stemEn: A child presented to ER with inspiratory stridor (croup-like picture). He received a dose of racemic epinephrine during his ER stay. When is rebound of symptoms expected after receiving racemic epinephrine?
explanationAr: تأثير epinephrine قصير نسبيًا؛ لذلك يجب مراقبة الطفل عادةً 2–4 ساعات بعد الجرعة لاحتمال عودة stridor أو respiratory distress.
reasoningEn: Symptoms can recur as the effect of nebulized epinephrine wears off, so observation for at least 2-4 hours is recommended.
incorrectOptionsAr: 30 دقيقة غالبًا مبكر جدًا، و6–8 ساعات أطول من نافذة المراقبة المعتادة المذكورة في المصدر.
clinicalPearl: Observe after nebulized epinephrine before discharge.

stemEn: A patient who had URTI symptoms for the last 3 days came now with high-grade fever, toxic appearance, barking cough and inspiratory stridor. X-ray was provided showing a steeple sign. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanationAr: وجود high fever + toxic appearance + worsening airway symptoms بعد أعراض URI يجعل bacterial tracheitis أكثر احتمالًا من uncomplicated viral croup. Steeple sign ليس خاصًا بالحَنجرة الفيروسية وحدها.
reasoningEn: Bacterial tracheitis should be suspected when croup-like illness worsens with toxic appearance and high fever.
incorrectOptionsAr: Viral croup غالبًا أقل toxic ولا يصاحبه عادةً هذا التدهور مع حرارة مرتفعة جدًا.
clinicalPearl: Steeple sign is nonspecific; toxic deterioration after croup is a key clue to bacterial tracheitis.

stemEn: A 4-year-old boy came to ER with barking cough. He received an oral steroid dose and was discharged. Later he presented with severe croup and high-grade fever (40°C). He is ill-looking. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanationAr: الطفل بدأ بصورة croup ثم عاد مع high-grade fever وill appearance وتدهور واضح؛ هذه علامة امتحانية كلاسيكية لـ bacterial tracheitis كـ complication أو mimic للحَنجرة الفيروسية.
reasoningEn: Marked worsening with high fever and toxic appearance after croup therapy strongly suggests bacterial tracheitis.
incorrectOptionsAr: Viral croup وحده أقل سمية عادةً. Foreign body لا يفسر الحمى العالية. Retropharyngeal abscess عادةً يبرز معه neck stiffness/dysphagia أكثر من barking cough.
clinicalPearl: Think bacterial tracheitis when presumed croup becomes toxic or fails standard therapy.

stemEn: A 4-year-old child with barking cough received dexamethasone and was discharged, then returned with respiratory distress, inspiratory stridor, high-grade fever. He required intubation and had copious purulent tracheal discharge. What is the antibiotic of choice?
explanationAr: الصورة هي bacterial tracheitis. المصدر يختار vancomycin لأن S. aureus/MRSA مهم، لكنه ينبه صراحةً أن vancomycin لا يُستخدم وحده عادةً؛ empiric therapy ينبغي أن تشمل vancomycin مع ceftriaxone/cefotaxime أو ampicillin-sulbactam.
reasoningEn: The source key is vancomycin, but its own explanation states empiric therapy should combine vancomycin with broader beta-lactam coverage.
incorrectOptionsAr: Ceftriaxone وحده قد لا يغطي MRSA. Ampicillin وحده أضيق من المطلوب.
clinicalPearl: Do not publish vancomycin monotherapy as the full regimen; the source itself recommends combination empiric coverage.

sourceRefs.sourceName: Pediatric Saudi Board Exams Question Collection 4th Ed 2026
sourceRefs.notes: Source key B but explanation recommends combination therapy

stemEn: A patient presented with fever, inspiratory stridor, and difficulty breathing. He keeps his neck extended. Lateral neck X-ray shows increased prevertebral space. What is the treatment?
explanationAr: الصورة تتماشى مع retropharyngeal infection. المصدر يذكر أن empiric therapy يجب أن يغطي GAS وS. aureus وanaerobes، ومن الخيارات clindamycin هو الأنسب لأن ampicillin-sulbactam غير موجود.
reasoningEn: Clindamycin is an acceptable empiric regimen in the source when ampicillin-sulbactam is not offered.
incorrectOptionsAr: Ampicillin وحده لا يعادل ampicillin-sulbactam. Ceftriaxone أو vancomycin منفردين لا يقدمان تغطية متوازنة كما في الخيارات الموصى بها.
clinicalPearl: Airway compromise takes priority over imaging or drainage decisions.

stemEn: A child presented with drooling, sick appearance, left neck swelling, and inability to turn the head left. CT shows a ring-enhancing lesion lateral to the pharynx. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanationAr: Ring-enhancing collection lateral to the pharynx مع neck swelling وtorticollis يدعم parapharyngeal abscess.
reasoningEn: The location lateral to the pharynx supports a parapharyngeal abscess.
incorrectOptionsAr: Retropharyngeal abscess يكون خلف البلعوم. Peritonsillar abscess يكون حول tonsil مع uvular deviation عادةً. Lymphadenitis لا يفسر deep ring-enhancing collection بهذا الوصف.
clinicalPearl: Deep neck space infections can threaten the airway and require prompt ENT involvement.

stemEn: A sick child presented with drooling and respiratory distress. X-ray showed the thumb sign. What is the most likely causative organism (vaccination history not mentioned)?
explanationAr: Thumb sign مع drooling وrespiratory distress يشير إلى epiglottitis. المصدر يختار Hib، مع ملاحظة أن Hib ما زال سببًا مهمًا خصوصًا في غير المطعمين أو ناقصي التطعيم.
reasoningEn: The source identifies Hib as the recalled causative organism for epiglottitis in this stem.
incorrectOptionsAr: Parainfluenza يرتبط أكثر بـ croup. S. aureus يمكن أن يسبب epiglottitis لكنه ليس المفتاح المذكور في المصدر لهذا السؤال.
clinicalPearl: Do not agitate a child with suspected epiglottitis; airway management comes first.

stemEn: A 3-year-old child with 2 days of URTI developed fever, barking cough, inspiratory stridor, drooling, toxic appearance, respiratory distress, RR 30, SpO2 93% on room air, leaning forward and neck tenderness. What will you do next?
explanationAr: وجود drooling + toxic appearance + tripod/leaning-forward posture + stridor يثير الشك بقوة في epiglottitis مع impending airway obstruction. الأولوية هي secure airway بطريقة controlled بواسطة فريق خبير قبل أدوية أو فحوصات أخرى.
reasoningEn: The child has signs of critical upper airway obstruction concerning for epiglottitis; securing the airway is the priority.
incorrectOptionsAr: Antibiotics وsteroids تأتي بعد تأمين airway. Racemic epinephrine موجه أكثر إلى croup. مجرد استدعاء الجراحة لا يسبق تثبيت مجرى الهواء في طفل غير مستقر.
clinicalPearl: In suspected epiglottitis, avoid aggressive throat examination and keep the child calm until the airway is secured.
